title: Turkish Kebabs with Gluten-Free Wraps
description: A flavorful and healthy take on traditional Turkish kebabs, served with gluten-free wraps for a convenient and satisfying meal.
instructions: Thread the kebabs onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together zesty and silky.
Brush the mixture onto the kebabs.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, prepare the gluten-free wraps by mixing flour and water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired wrap size.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Grill the wraps for 30-60 seconds on each side, until lightly charred.
Serve the kebabs in the gluten-free wraps with your favorite toppings.
